01 / Understanding

AI SEO / Strategy

Can people clearly understand your business online?

AI-powered search systems differ in their choice of sources and how they present them. We therefore do not promise specific mentions. Instead, we improve the conditions for content to be understood clearly and referenced meaningfully. We check whether services, businesses, locations and statements are clearly identifiable. Claims should be accurate and supported wherever readers need sources.

Good answers need reliable statements.
